author: Absolab
body:
I have already talked to Grape (greg) and myworld about this problem, but there is something puzzling to who i said it too. I remember I was in a skype call with my team and some of us used chat to communicate with each other and joke around.

I would like know know or see the logs to who i said the suicide encouragement to.  Because in the evidence it was cropped from a screenshot (  http://imgur.com/cbEAvk2 ) and on top of my name (Arila) has a gold name on top, and I know a lot of people from my team had a Gold rank and the other team have 1 gold rank but his name doesn't fit the number of characters in the screenshot. I believe the person I said "kys" to is BeanTwo. She was in the call with me and when I typed it in chat, I said in the call, I love you, i was joking and etc and she know I was. If you can check the logs to all Gold ranks from Heartless and Necromancy to see who I said "Kys" to. Sorry if its troubling but i honestly think it was a mis-communication between both teams to who is speaking to who. 


Sorry for the trouble into a temp ban.
